name: Cu Chi
provinceNote: From 1 July 2025 the old huyện Củ Chi is seven communes. The new xã Củ Chi is only Tân Phú Trung, Tân Thông Hội, and Phước Vĩnh An. It is not the tunnel gate. Bến Dược is in xã An Nhơn Tây. Bến Đình is in xã Nhuận Đức.
dotReason: Worth it if you are already nearby
summary: A network of wartime tunnels northwest of Ho Chi Minh City, preserved as two historic sites. Walk the conserved tunnels at Ben Dinh or Ben Duoc and try steamed cassava and local rice paper. An easy day trip from the city for anyone interested in the war.
fee: No single ticket for both gates. From 1 Feb 2026, operator foreign notice: historical-site admission 35,000 đồng and a service-and-guide ticket 100,000 đồng. Those lines are not a combined total, and that notice does not give a Vietnamese ticket. The service ticket had been 90,000 đồng. Tourism center and 23 Apr 2024 press: 70,000 đồng for an international visitor and 35,000 đồng for a Vietnamese adult. The tourism center gives no effective date on the 70,000 đồng. Tourism center: half price for students and children 7–16; free under 7, for people with disabilities, for the armed forces, and for revolution contributors. A 2005 decision set 15,000 đồng an adult and 7,000 đồng a child from 1 Jan 2006. Tourism center: 65,000 đồng for the liberated zone. The operator notice does not. A price only for Bến Đình: Check on arrival. Shooting, boats, and paintball: Check on arrival. Trăng chiến khu: 399,000 đồng a person. Homestay rate: Check on arrival. Taxi: 600,000–700,000 đồng a trip, gate not named. Bus fare: Check on arrival. Canoe from bến Bạch Đằng, including Greenlines: described as high, no number — Check on arrival. Incense at the memorial, a drink on a night show, and a stall price: Check on arrival.
getThere: Bến Dược: about one hour by road from the city centre (homestay note, 31 May 2025), no kilometre. Press, 23 Apr 2024: about 70 km, gates not split, no minute. Tourism center: approximately 70 km northwest, with Provincial Road 15 and Phú Hiệp in the same sentence, no minute. Bến Đình kilometres: Check on arrival. Minutes between the two gates: Check on arrival. Buses, 4 Jul 2014 note: bus 13 from Bến Thành, or 94 from Chợ Lớn, to bến xe Củ Chi, then 79, and that note names route 79 “Củ Chi – Dầu Tiếng”. Tourism center: bus 13 or 94, then 79 to Bến Dược, and it does not use the Dầu Tiếng name. Bến Đình, 2014 note and tourism center: 13 or 94 to An Sương, 122 to Tân Quy, then 70. Self-drive, 2014 note: Trường Chinh, ngã tư An Sương, Hóc Môn, then Provincial Road 15, to “địa đạo Củ Chi”. The operator puts Provincial Road 15 on Bến Đình. Drive minutes: Check on arrival. Minutes from Tân Sơn Nhất and from Ga Sài Gòn: Check on arrival. Ga Sài Gòn ends the national line in the city, not in Củ Chi. Metro Tham Lương–Củ Chi is described as preparation, with completion written as 2035. It is not a station you can board. Ordinary gate: 7:00–17:00, including Saturday, Sunday, and Tết. Trăng chiến khu 2026: 1 Jan, 18:00–20:40; 7 Mar, 18:00–20:30; 4 Apr, 18:00–20:40; a notice titled August 2026 whose body says September 2026 and the date 24 Aug 2026, 18:00–20:40. Next night: Check on arrival. Lengths: longer than 200 km of tunnels, with about 500 km of surface trenches (heritage agency); about nearly 250 km (23 Apr 2024 press); the system spreads over more than 250 km² (tourism center). Visitor section: about 120 meters on two levels. Do not use 120 meters as the wartime network. Which gate that section belongs to: Check on arrival. Depths: 3 m, 6 m, and 12 m (23 Apr 2024 press); 3 m, 6 m, and deeper than 12 m (tourism center). Heritage inventory: some stretches have two or three levels and does not give those metres. Formation: about 1948, earliest at Tân Phú Trung and Phước Vĩnh An (heritage inventory); 1946–1948, then a rapid build from 1961 to 1965 (tourism center). Memorial area: 40,299.3 m², started 19 May 1993, stage 1 opened 19 Dec 1995. Liberated zone: 38.5 hectares and three periods, 1961–1964, 1965–1968, and 1969–1972 (tourism center). Heritage cluster: 197,633.5 m² for the reconstruction, the East Sea mockup, and the Cedar Falls sand-table house, started 24 May 2008 and opened 19 Dec 2009. Rice-paper lanes at xã Phú Hòa Đông: more than 40 km from the city centre, and about 40 km. Walk minutes on the grounds: Check on arrival.
seoTitle: Cu Chi travel guide — wartime tunnels, Ben Dinh and Ben Duoc
seoDescription: The wartime tunnels northwest of Ho Chi Minh City, at two gates: Ben Duoc and Ben Dinh. A day from the city, with cassava and rice paper after the crawl.
intro: You come for the wartime tunnels: a dark mouth in the earth, leaves around the lip, the tree behind it, northwest of Ho Chi Minh City. Most visits sleep in the city and return the same day. The night on the relic, when the booking is here, is the homestay and tents on the Sài Gòn river at Bến Dược.

Bến Dược and Bến Đình stay two sites. Bến Dược is the regional command ground at ấp Phú Hiệp, now xã An Nhơn Tây. The English address is still Phu Hiep Hamlet, Phu My Hung Commune, Cu Chi District, and a Vietnamese spelling is xã Ân Nhơn Tây. From 1 July 2025 the old xã Phú Mỹ Hưng sits inside xã An Nhơn Tây. Bến Đình is the old district-committee base at ấp Bến Đình, xã Nhuận Đức, on Provincial Road 15. Do not send a driver to the new xã Củ Chi. Do not use 87A Trần Kế Xương in Phú Nhuận. That address is a 1955–1958 liaison office, not this ground.

The ordinary gate is 7:00–17:00, including Saturday, Sunday, and Tết. After 17:00 the grounds are quiet unless the night is Trăng chiến khu. The 2026 notices put the show at 18:00–20:30 or 18:00–20:40. That ticket is not the daytime gate. The desk is at ấp Phú Hiệp. Those notices do not put the show at Bến Đình.

Keep the gates apart. Bến Dược holds the memorial, the night program, and the river homestay. Bến Đình is the other gate. The published lengths are longer than 200 km of tunnels, about nearly 250 km, and an area of more than 250 km². A widened visitor section of about 120 meters on two levels is not the length of that network.
gettingAround: Bến Dược is about one hour by road from the city centre, and the tunnels are also given as about 70 km, without the gates split. Name the gate when you book the car.

For Bến Dược, take bus 13 from Bến Thành or 94 from Chợ Lớn to bến xe Củ Chi, then 79. Route 79 is named “Củ Chi – Dầu Tiếng” on the 2014 road note, and named only as the bus to Bến Dược on the tourism center line. For Bến Đình, take 13 or 94 to An Sương, 122 to Tân Quy, then 70.

Self-drive follows Trường Chinh, ngã tư An Sương, Hóc Môn, then Provincial Road 15. A taxi is given at 600,000–700,000 đồng a trip, without the gate named. A canoe on the Sài Gòn from bến Bạch Đằng, including Greenlines, is the river way in. Ga Sài Gòn ends the national line in the city, not in Củ Chi. The Tham Lương–Củ Chi metro is preparation, with completion written as 2035, and it is not a station you can board.

Inside Bến Dược, an overnight booking includes a bicycle around the East Sea lake. Shooting, boats, paintball, and other bicycles are also named. The range is given as AK-47 and AR-15, on a separate ticket.

stayAreas.name: Ho Chi Minh City
stayAreas.summary: Return to Ho Chi Minh City the same day. The ordinary gate closes at 17:00.

eat: Rice paper is the craft at xã Phú Hòa Đông, dried in the sun. The lanes are more than 40 km from the city centre, and also about 40 km.

Boiled tapioca with sesame salt is the plate at the Hoàng Cầm kitchen, and the same root is also dipped in salt. Along National Highway 22 are Cu Chi veal, pork-knuckle noodle soup, and durian sugarcane juice. Trung An has rambutan, mangosteen, durian, and jackfruit. Veal rolled in rice paper, young jackfruit salad, and bamboo-shoot salad are named too. More plates are at chợ Củ Chi and chợ Việt Kiều.

interestGroups.title: The two tunnel grounds
interestGroups.summary: For a day on the relic, when the wartime tunnels are the reason you came.
body: Bến Dược is where the regional leadership worked. The ground splits into Khu A, the military command, and Khu B, the party committee. On the same ground you can enter Đền Tưởng niệm Liệt sĩ Bến Dược, the liberated-zone reconstruction, the East Sea lake with three miniature monuments, and a live-fire range. Bến Đình is the district-committee base: hidden lids, a round tunnel mouth, termite-mound vents, an M41 tank, and a reconstructed craft yard for rice paper, rice alcohol, and rice pounding.

The whole Cu Chi relic is a special national relic by Quyết định 2367/QĐ-TTg of 23 Dec 2015. Bến Dược alone was a national historic site by Quyết định 54/VHQĐ of 29 Apr 1979. Bến Đình was recognized by Quyết định 101/2004/QĐ-BVHTT of 15 Dec 2004.

The memorial started on 19 May 1993, with stage 1 opened on 19 Dec 1995, and the heritage inventory gives it 40,299.3 m², with a basement of nine display sections under the title of Sài Gòn – Gia Định. The liberated zone is given as 38.5 hectares and three periods, 1961–1964, 1965–1968, and 1969–1972. A larger cluster, the reconstruction plus the East Sea mockup and the Cedar Falls sand-table house, is 197,633.5 m², started 24 May 2008 and opened 19 Dec 2009. Those are not the same boundary.

blocks.heading: The memorial at Bến Dược
paragraphs: Đền Tưởng niệm Liệt sĩ Bến Dược is on the Bến Dược ground. The start is dated 19 May 1993 and stage 1 to 19 Dec 1995. The temple is given as 40,299.3 m², with a basement of nine display sections under the title of Sài Gòn – Gia Định. The 2021 notice names incense at the memorial.

blocks.heading: After 17:00
paragraphs: On an ordinary day the gate closes at 17:00. Arriving at 19:00 and expecting the grounds to be open wastes the evening. On a Trăng chiến khu night the path is a moonlit village, a staged night of tunnel digging, and a performance. People who do not want the late return are pointed at the homestay, nhà nghỉ, and tents. The show starts at 18:00 and the published ends are 20:30 and 20:40.

blocks.heading: Morning on the river
paragraphs: If you slept at the homestay, the morning is birds in the trees, wind off the river, a coffee on the grounds, a bicycle around the East Sea lake, and a walk in the planted forest. Breakfast for an overnight booking is at the restaurant on the grounds. The pool is free with that booking.

cards.title: Tunnel entrance
cards.summary: A lid in the leaves, and a dark mouth in the earth. These are the wartime tunnels. Ask which gate you are booked into.

interestGroups.title: Shopping
interestGroups.summary: Rice-paper lanes at Phú Hòa Đông, Chợ Quê inside the gate, and the two town markets.

blocks.heading: Phú Hòa Đông rice paper
paragraphs: The workshop lanes are in xã Phú Hòa Đông, on the river, where the sheets dry in the sun. One mix is rice flour with coconut water, salt, sugar, and sesame depending on the batch. An older mix is rice flour, water, and salt. The craft is given as more than 50 years and as more than 80 years. The lanes are more than 40 km from the city centre, and also about 40 km.

blocks.heading: Chợ Quê, chợ Củ Chi, chợ Việt Kiều
paragraphs: Chợ Quê is the market inside the tunnel gate, where visitors eat. The ordinary gate that day runs 7:00–17:00.
Chợ Củ Chi and chợ Việt Kiều are the town markets for steamed cassava, stir-fried bánh lọt, bánh bao, hủ tiếu, chicken bánh canh, and Cambodian-style bánh khọt.

cards.title: Rice paper and the markets
cards.summary: Phú Hòa Đông rice-paper lanes, Chợ Quê inside the gate, and chợ Củ Chi with chợ Việt Kiều.

faqs.a: Name the gate. Bến Dược is ấp Phú Hiệp, now xã An Nhơn Tây, and it is the ground with the memorial, the night show, and the river homestay. Bến Đình is ấp Bến Đình, xã Nhuận Đức, on Provincial Road 15. The new xã Củ Chi is Tân Phú Trung, Tân Thông Hội, and Phước Vĩnh An. It is not either gate.

faqs.q: How far is Cu Chi from the city centre?
faqs.a: Bến Dược is about one hour by road, with no kilometre on that note. The tunnels are also given as about 70 km, and as approximately 70 km northwest, without the gates split. Bến Đình does not have its own kilometre on those lines.

faqs.q: What does a daytime ticket cost?
faqs.a: From 1 Feb 2026 a foreign visitor is listed at 35,000 đồng for historical-site admission and 100,000 đồng for the service-and-guide ticket. Do not add those into one total. The service ticket had been 90,000 đồng. An international visitor is also listed at 70,000 đồng, and a Vietnamese adult at 35,000 đồng. Students and children 7–16 are half price on the tourism center line, and entry is free under 7, for people with disabilities, for the armed forces, and for revolution contributors. A 2005 decision set 15,000 đồng an adult and 7,000 đồng a child from 1 Jan 2006. The liberated zone is 65,000 đồng on the tourism center line and is absent from the operator notice. Ask the Bến Đình-only price, and the price for shooting, boats, and paintball, at the desk.
A homestay and tents sit on the Sài Gòn river at Bến Dược. Breakfast for an overnight booking is included. The dish is not named. Otherwise return to Ho Chi Minh City after 17:00.

It is a single night, not a fixed weekday. The 2026 dates already named are 1 Jan, 7 Mar, 4 Apr, and 24 Aug. The show starts at 18:00. The published ends are 20:30 and 20:40. The August notice’s title and its September wording do not match the 24 Aug date. Each of those tickets is 399,000 đồng. Ask which night is next.

season.label: Quiet after 17:00
season.note: The ordinary gate is 7:00–17:00, including Saturday, Sunday, and Tết. Come in the morning. On a Trăng chiến khu night the show starts at 18:00 and ends at 20:30 or 20:40. That night is a separate ticket.
